source_name: World Bank Commodity Markets — Pink Sheet (Monthly Prices)
source_note: Monthly nominal USD commodity prices ingested from the local data/raw_material_pink_sheet.xlsx (World Bank CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly). Aluminum / Copper / Nickel / Lead are LME spot. Iron Ore is the 62% Fe CFR China benchmark. Natural Rubber is TSR20 USD/kg.
